google.step2: Enable the Admin SDK API for that project.
google.step3: In the Google Admin console, open Security, then API controls, then Domain-wide delegation, and add the service account using its client ID.
google.step4: Grant it the read-only directory scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.user.readonly and https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.group.readonly.
google.step5: Upload the JSON key below and enter the email of a Google Workspace admin to read the directory as.

okta.step2: Open the Provisioning tab and select the Integration setting.
okta.step3: Paste the SCIM endpoint URL and bearer token found below.
